sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership dominates as Energy and Healthcare post matching top momentum scores (0.883), while cyclical groups lose ground.

Breadth remains concentrated, with only 3 of 11 sectors holding all-green status across week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD timeframes. Leadership is heavily tilted toward Energy and Healthcare, both showing sustained top-three positioning across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Consumer Defensive is reinforcing this defensive rotation, advancing to rank 4 with a solid 0.750 momentum score.

Meanwhile, cyclical and rate-sensitive sectors are fading. Industrials and Basic Materials both surrendered 2 rank spots over the past 5 sessions, dropping to ranks 6 and 5, respectively. Growth and cyclical laggards remain pinned to the bottom of the table, with Consumer Cyclical sitting at rank 11 (0.400 momentum) and Utilities trailing the entire market with a momentum reading of 0.200.

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 sectors—Energy (0.883), Healthcare (0.883), and Consumer Defensive (0.750)—are positive across all tracked time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, YTD).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Energy (YTD rank 1) and Healthcare (YTD rank 3) remain firmly entrenched at the top, maintaining top-3 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Defensive Clustering:** Consumer Defensive rounds out the top tier at rank 4, posting a 0.750 momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Healthcare Surges:** Healthcare posted the strongest short-term move, gaining +3 spots over 5 sessions to claim rank 3 with a 0.883 momentum score.
- **Cyclicals and Value Fading:** Basic Materials, Industrials, and Communication Services each dropped -2 spots over the last 5 sessions, falling to ranks 5 (0.43 momentum), 6 (0.283 momentum), and 9 (0.267 momentum).
- **Momentum Polarities:** Energy (0.883) and Healthcare (0.883) lead all sectors in momentum, while Utilities (0.200) and Communication Services (0.267) sit at the absolute bottom.

## Divergences
- **Technology Rank vs. Momentum:** Technology holds the #2 spot YTD, but its momentum score has softened to a middling 0.567.
- **Cyclical Stagnation:** Consumer Cyclical remains locked at the bottom (rank 11) with a weak 0.400 momentum score, despite minor rank bumps in other lagging sectors like Financial (+1 spot to rank 7, 0.483 momentum) and Real Estate (+1 spot to rank 8, 0.350 momentum).

rotation_phase.label: Defensive
rotation_phase.reasoning: Healthcare and Consumer Defensive are leading the market alongside Energy while cyclical sectors lag, reflecting a classic flight to non-cyclical safety.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy, Healthcare, and Travel-related groups dominate broad multi-timeframe strength, while cyclicals and software infrastructure deteriorate sharply.

Market breadth shows selective resilience, with 28 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green profiles across weekly through YTD timeframes. Leadership remains anchored in traditional energy—such as Oil & Gas Integrated and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing—alongside travel services and medical distribution. 

Meanwhile, rotation is evident as capital flows into defensive healthcare and consumer staples, while high-profile infrastructure and industrial segments slide. Engineering & Construction, Coking Coal, and Internet Content & Information suffered steep 5-day rank declines, accompanied by momentum degradation in infrastructure software.

## Strength
- **Core Leadership:** Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.893, rank YTD 4) and REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.895, rank YTD 7) lead overall market momentum among the 28 all-green groups.
- **Sustained Dominance:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holds the #1 YTD rank with a 0.862 momentum score, joined by sustained cross-timeframe strength in Medical Distribution, Oil & Gas E&P, and Health Information Services.
- **Defensive Durability:** Health Information Services (momentum 0.85) and Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.85) continue to post positive performance across week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD periods.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Climbers:** Drug Manufacturers - General jumped 19 spots to rank 38 (momentum 0.83), while Lodging gained 17 spots to rank 29 (momentum 0.88).
- **Healthcare Accumulation:** Healthcare Plans rose 15 spots to rank 17 (momentum 0.84), Medical Distribution rose 14 spots to rank 40 (momentum 0.89), and Biotechnology advanced 16 spots to rank 42 (momentum 0.70).
- **Severe De-rankings:** Engineering & Construction dropped 35 spots to rank 63 (momentum 0.23), Coking Coal lost 28 spots to rank 119 (momentum 0.23), and Internet Content & Information dropped 21 spots to rank 72 (momentum 0.47).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Solar (0.052, rank YTD 140), Uranium (0.059, rank YTD 128), and Advertising Agencies (0.080, rank YTD 144) remain anchored at the bottom of the rankings.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Software - Infrastructure displays a breakdown, shedding 19 spots in 5 sessions down to rank 53 despite a moderate momentum reading of 0.60.
- **Tech & Cyclical Slippage:** Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.69, rank -3 in 5d), Copper (momentum 0.66, rank -3 in 5d), and Software - Application (momentum 0.61, rank -3 in 5d) are exhibiting fading performance.
- **Emerging Bottom Turnarounds:** Early ranking improvements are forming in low-momentum consumer areas, led by Home Improvement Retail (rank +9 in 5d, momentum 0.44), Restaurants (rank +6 in 5d, momentum 0.44), and Packaged Foods (rank +6 in 5d, momentum 0.39).
